scientific_integrity: An explicit all-parameter proof is included. Two standalone finite checkers corroborate n=3 through n=8; they are not substitutes for the general proof. No external independent audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Only minimum ordinary zero forcing sets on crown graphs with at least three matched pairs.
Single-vertex replacement is unrestricted by base-graph adjacency.

The prior all-set characterization for matching-deleted complete bipartite graphs already implies the minimum forcing-set count; novelty is restricted to the exact reconfiguration metric and its distance distribution.
Equivalence with unindexed prior configuration-space results remains possible.
title: Exact reconfiguration distances for minimum zero forcing sets of crown graphs
